reviews.comment: Good teacher, his labs are good and very helpful, but the lectures get boring. He is professional and has open office hours, just don't be absent without an excuse.

Mate Joe is one of the best professors at TAMUG and there's a reason everyone talks about him. He teaches a difficult subject very well and he really cares about his students. He'll help you in any way he can to make sure you understand. Tnav can be difficult, so practice plotting and study!!! Joe is awesome though and probably as good as it gets

Pro: 
- Mate Joe is one of the few instructors at A&M Galveston Maritime Academy who can teach
- Fast grader with tests
- The ONLY sane with common-sense instructor for freshman year MART class
Cons: 
- He's overworked with the new TNav course (poor guy)
- Some labs might be returned late. 
- He's hot, so it's distracting to listen to him in class.

Takes a while to grade, but a very good teacher, knows the material and does a great job explaining it. However, time is required outside of class. Mate Joe is one of my favorite teachers here, with passion and care for the subject, and will do everything he can to help you learn and comprehend the material. Highly recommend him!
Tough grader, great person, great at explaining material.

Mate Joe is a great professor with a positive personality. His lectures are clear and concise, and he makes sure to clarify any misunderstandings in lab. Complete all of the assigned work, and the class won't be difficult for you. Make sure to ask questions if unsure. As with most professors, if you put in the effort, your grade will reflect it.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
